arguments.message:
Created new VIL plugin `vil_metrics` for gathering system metrics:

**Created files:**
- `crates/vil_metrics/Cargo.toml` - Package manifest with sysinfo dependency
- `crates/vil_metrics/src/lib.rs` - Module exports
- `crates/vil_metrics/src/error.rs` - Error types
- `crates/vil_metrics/src/metrics.rs` - Data structures (SystemSnapshot, CpuMetrics, MemoryMetrics, DiskMetrics, NetworkMetrics)
- `crates/vil_metrics/src/collector.rs` - MetricsCollector with configurable polling
- `crates/vil_metrics/src/plugin.rs` - SystemMetricsPlugin with background collection

**Features:**
- CPU metrics (overall + per-core usage, frequency, brand)
- Memory metrics (total, used, available, swap)
- Disk metrics (per-mountpoint info with usage %)
- Network metrics (RX/TX bytes, packets, errors per interface)
- Configurable polling interval
- In-memory history with retention policy
- Background collection task
- JSON serialization for HTTP endpoints
- Optional VIL integration feature for future server integration

**Integration:**
- Added to workspace in Cargo.toml
- All tests pass (2 tests)
- Workspace check passes
